q2.with_q1_role: one dependency ablation using the no-Q1 selected configuration

conditional_weighting.trigger: any fixed-label true class has zero predictions in an unweighted primary repeat

selection: then smaller max_leaf_nodes and configuration index
within 0.5 percent minimize mean normalized AP/system MAE
then minimize worst absolute median signed bias
then prefer direct, smaller max_leaf_nodes, and configuration index

final_full_data_configuration_rule.q2: apply the frozen Q2 lexicographic rule to all 45 primary inner-fold records for each grid configuration; weighting status is chosen only by outer promotion
final_full_data_configuration_rule.q3: apply the frozen Q3 lexicographic rule to all 45 primary inner-fold records for each architecture-grid candidate; AP-count split status is chosen only by outer promotion
final_full_data_configuration_rule.fallback: Q1-B1, Q2-B1A, Q3-B1 when no S4 candidate passes promotion
